title: 第11章 苍澜酒楼第12章 引雷诀
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
翟连山行礼后垂头丧气的走了。
朔衡漫不经心的瞥了一眼周围还在围观的仙宫弟子，见他们犹豫着要不要上前行礼，顿时失去兴趣。
“大哥，我饿了。”朔衡拽拽朔千夜的袖子。
“好，我们这就去吃饭。”
翟连山的出现并未在朔衡心里留下什么痕迹。
绿色的气运，带着一丝浅蓝，不是什么能让朔衡感兴趣的人。
苍澜酒楼坐落在享悦街最繁华的地段，人来人往，络绎不绝。
精致的庭院，有着清雅的装饰点缀。
即便是不吃饭光看这景色，也能让人心情愉悦。
“两位公子，二楼请。”小厮穿着得体干练的灰白色短袍，将两人引去了楼上。
苍澜酒楼共有三层。
第一层，寻常弟子都能进入。
而第二层，就有一些身份上的讲究了。
非亲传不能入，非长老不能入。
朔千夜虽说年纪小，但毕竟是苍澜亲口承认的亲传弟子，还给予了他苍澜峰亲传才能拥有的金色玉碟。
苍澜仙宫识人身份的方式基本就是通过系在腰间的小巧玉碟的颜色来判断。
外门弟子为黑色。
内门弟子为蓝色，其上用不同颜色勾勒的花纹代表各自所属山峰。
亲传弟子的玉碟，则就是所属山峰原本的颜色。
而当时翟连山之所以看不出朔衡的身份，也是因为他并未佩戴相对颜色的玉碟的缘故。

不过朔千夜腰间的金色玉碟可是极为显眼，所以小厮才会直接将人带去二楼。
“公子，您看看想吃些什么？”
朔千夜的口腹之欲不强，于是他把菜单放在朔衡面前：“小衡点吧，想吃什么，今日我请客。”
朔衡扬起一个笑脸：“那我就不客气啦~”
【小四，点菜。】
于是朔衡报了一通菜名，在小厮颇为惊讶的目光中，满意的合上菜单。
这小家伙看起来很是面生，应该是第一次来，没想到竟然对他们酒楼极为熟悉，点的菜都颇具盛名。
“两位公子请稍等。”小厮心中愈发恭敬，提着菜单退了下去。
朔衡这才有时间打量酒楼二层的模样。
比起一层，这里的摆设明显更加精致华丽。
甚至还能听到从不知何处传来的袅袅琴音。
他们坐的位置靠窗，两侧都有隔断，像个小包间。
朔衡从木窗向外看去，几乎能看到享悦街的全景。
修士的生活就是这么朴实无华啊……
朔衡举起茶杯喝了一口。
嗯，连茶水里都是带着灵气的。
“吃些点心。”朔千夜把桌上的糕点往朔衡的方向推了推。
他在朔家跟朔衡相处的时间并不长。
除了当初朔衡出生时见过一面，接下来的一年时间里，他在朔阳的指导下忙于修炼，而朔衡年纪小，根本不能到处溜达。
所以两人几乎没见过面。

即便见面，也是大人们在谈事情，两人遥遥相望，对视一眼。
可偏偏，朔家上下的族弟族妹之中，他最喜欢的就是朔衡。
content_en:
Zhai Lianshan saluted and left dejectedly.
Shuo Heng casually glanced at the Immortal Palace disciples who were still watching. Seeing that they were hesitant to step forward and salute, he immediately lost interest.
"Brother, I'm hungry." Shuo Heng tugged on Shuo Qianye's sleeve.
"Okay, let's go eat now."
Zhai Lianshan's appearance did not leave any trace in Shuo Heng's heart.
Green luck, with a hint of light blue, is not something that interests Shuo Heng.
Canglan Restaurant is located in the most prosperous area of ​​Xiangyue Street, with a constant stream of people coming and going.
The exquisite courtyard is decorated with elegant decorations.
Even if you don’t eat, just looking at the scenery can make you feel happy.
"You two gentlemen, please come to the second floor." The young man, wearing a smart gray short robe, led the two of them upstairs.
Canglan Restaurant has three floors.
On the first level, ordinary disciples can enter.
On the second level, there are some status considerations.
No one who is not a descendant can enter, and no one who is not an elder can enter.
Although Shuo Qianye was young, he was still recognized as a direct disciple by Cang Lan, and he was also given a golden jade plate that could only be owned by a direct disciple of Canglan Peak.
The way Canglan Immortal Palace identifies people is basically by the color of the small jade disc tied around their waist.
Outer disciples are black.
The inner disciples are blue, and the patterns outlined in different colors represent the peaks they belong to.
The jade plate of a direct disciple is the original color of the mountain it belongs to.
At that time, the reason why Zhai Lianshan could not identify Shuo Heng's identity was because he was not wearing a jade plate of the corresponding color.
However, the golden jade plate on Shuo Qianye's waist was extremely conspicuous, so the servant took him directly to the second floor.
"Sir, what do you want to eat?"
Shuo Qianye's appetite was not strong, so he put the menu in front of Shuo Heng: "Xiao Heng, please order. Whatever you want to eat, I will treat you today."
Shuo Heng raised a smile: "Then I'm welcome~"
[Little Four, order. 】
So Shuo Heng reported the names of the dishes, and in the surprised eyes of the waiter, he closed the menu with satisfaction.
This little guy looks very unfamiliar. It must be his first time here. Unexpectedly, he is very familiar with their restaurant and the dishes he ordered are quite famous.
"You two gentlemen, please wait a moment." The waiter became more respectful and stepped back with the menu in hand.
Only then did Shuo Heng have time to look at the second floor of the restaurant.
Compared with the first floor, the furnishings here are obviously more exquisite and gorgeous.
You can even hear the faint sound of piano coming from nowhere.
They were sitting by the window, with partitions on both sides, like a small private room.
Shuo Heng looked out from the wooden window and could almost see the whole view of Xiangyue Street.
The life of a monk is so simple and unpretentious...
Shuo Heng raised his tea cup and took a sip.
Well, even the tea is filled with spiritual energy.
"Eat some snacks." Shuo Qianye pushed the pastries on the table in the direction of Shuo Heng.
He didn't spend long time with Shuo Heng at Shuo's house.
Except for meeting Shuo Heng once when he was born, he spent the next year busy practicing under the guidance of Shuo Yang, and Shuo Heng was young and couldn't wander around at all.
So the two almost never met.
Even when they meet, it's the adults talking about things. The two of them look at each other from a distance and look at each other.
But unfortunately, among the younger brothers and sisters in the Shuo family, his favorite was Shuo Heng.
